title: refactor: rename Phase 0 -> MVP and Phase 1 -> post-MVP
body:
"Phase 0" and "Phase 1" were ambiguous — neither term carried any intrinsic meaning, and users reading the repo cold (now the primary audience per the README rewrite) had to context-switch to HANDOFF.md to learn what each phase meant. Replace with terms that name what they actually denote:

  Phase 0  ->  MVP        (the thing that ships today)
  Phase 1  ->  post-MVP   (the next big architecture step)

Mechanical, project-wide. No semantic changes; the MVP/post-MVP split blockquote in HANDOFF.md, the non-negotiables, the 'first-PR scope' contract, and every cross-reference all read the same — only the label changes.

Touched files (salvage/ excluded — read-only verbatim reference):

- HANDOFF.md       — central split blockquote, 'MVP first-PR scope'
                     section, all cross-refs. Also updated the
                     example branch name in §6 from feat/phase-0-scaffold
                     to feat/mvp-scaffold so future readers don't
                     copy obsolete terminology.
- README.md        — section titles, status note, body prose. Fixed
                     the broken anchor link in the GOOGLE_API_KEY
                     section (was #known-limitations-phase-0, now
                     #known-limitations-mvp matching the renamed
                     header).
- AGENTS.md (root) — routing prose and the 'Hard ground rules' list.
- raycast/AGENTS.md — section titles and paste-strategy-map notes.
- scripts/toggle-raycast-binding.sh — comments, the PHASE0_DIR
                     variable (now MVP_DIR), the public CLI arg
                     (now 'mvp' not 'phase0'), and the
                     printed-status string ('phase0' -> 'mvp').
                     Safe to break the CLI: no users have it
                     scripted, and 'status' / 'prototype' / no-arg
                     paths are unchanged.

Verification:
- `rg -i 'phase ?0|phase ?1|phase-?0|phase-?1'` outside salvage/ returns zero matches.
- `bash -n scripts/toggle-raycast-binding.sh` passes.
- `./scripts/toggle-raycast-binding.sh status` correctly reports current bindings as 'mvp' for the live symlinks (which point at this repo's raycast/ directory).
- `./scripts/toggle-raycast-binding.sh --help` renders the updated usage block.

Live flip path (`./scripts/toggle-raycast-binding.sh prototype` then back to `mvp`) NOT exercised — it would change the user's working Raycast bindings. Will happen naturally the next time the toggle is used in anger.

Intentionally NOT touched: the literal git-history branch name 'feat/phase-0-scaffold' as it appears in commit messages and the already-merged PR title. Git history is not rewritten.

What 'Phase 1' meant under the old terminology is now 'post-MVP' throughout — the work itself (FastAPI app, src/voiceitt_bridge/, tests/, the in-page UX triggers) is unchanged.
